asset_manifests.name: Geological Clinometer
asset_manifests.visual_identity: A precision hand-held sighting compass and clinometer; features a rugged, rectangular aluminum body in 'Industrial Orange'; includes two side-viewing windows with a dual-scale internal dial for measuring slope angles and strike/dip of rock layers; a black nylon lanyard is attached to the base.
asset_manifests.notes: Essential for Paleontologist 04 and 01 when documenting the angle of 'Centrosaurus ribs projecting from a tall sandstone cliff'. Used to determine the exact tilt of sedimentary layers in the Morrison Formation.
